pinterest.title: Same-Sex Marriage in Greece: What Australian Couples Need to Know
pinterest.description: As at November 2026, same-sex marriage in Greece is legal. Since 16 February 2024, Law 5089/2024 has allowed civil marriage between two persons of the same sex, performed by a municipal registrar. Our guide covers the documents Australian couples usually need, the Certificate of No Impediment from the Australian Embassy in Athens, and whether your Greek marriage is recognised at home.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Can you legally marry your same-sex partner in Greece? As at November 2026, yes.

Since 16 February 2024, Greek law has allowed civil marriage between two persons of different or the same sex. It is a civil marriage before a municipal registrar, so any church or religious element sits outside it.

For Australian couples, the questions are practical. The municipality where you marry sets the documents, and each one may ask for something different. Rhodes, for example, lists a joint application, a certificate of no impediment for each of you naming the person you will marry, passport copies and a fee. Foreign documents need an official Greek translation, and an Apostille for countries outside the European Union.

The Australian Embassy in Athens issues Certificates of No Impediment by appointment. Same-sex marriages that took place overseas are generally recognised in Australia, and if yours is, a later ceremony at home is a recommitment, not a second marriage.

Our new guide covers the documents, the civil ceremony, recognition at home and the questions to ask a venue, starting with whether it hosts same-sex weddings, in writing.

The paperwork sits with you, your municipality and the embassy. Everything around it is where we come in. Send us a message with your island and guest count, and your Wedded Advisor, one person from start to finish, will plan the venue, travel, vendors and payments around your civil ceremony, in your time zone and with the fee agreed in writing before any work begins. Full guide at the link in our bio.
